# Enrichment routes that stay on FastAPI after plan 06. One "METHOD /path/{param}" per line.
# Go must not register them; infra/nginx/go-routes.conf (plan 06 section) keeps them on api_backend at every
# canary percentage. Reasons: generate-column calls the LLM (D2, copilot plan), provider-accuracy runs the offline
# eval harness over a Python-only golden set (D3), source preview runs a collection preview (D6).
POST /api/v2/workbooks/{workbook_id}/generate-column
GET /api/workbooks/meta/provider-accuracy
GET /api/workbooks/{workbook_id}/sources/{col_id}/preview
